## Gamma Distribution Examples

```{r toc, echo=FALSE}
thisfile <- knitr::current_input()
revised_toc(thisfile, base_level = 3, toc_depth = 1)
```

---

### Probability Density Function

Get Probability Density Function plots that specify no limits, numeric limits, and probability limits, respectively.
```{r,gammaPDF}
gamma.pdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1))
gamma.pdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1), limits = c(1, 4))
gamma.pdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1), probs = c(.2, .8))
```

### Cumulative Distribution Function

Get Cumulative Distribution Function plots that specify no limits, numeric limits, and probability limits, respectively.
```{r,gammaCDF}
gamma.cdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1))
gamma.cdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1), limits = c(1, 4))
gamma.cdf(params = c(shape = 3, rate = 1), probs = c(.2, .8))
```
